entities.name: Age of Empire / New Imperialism
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The period (c. 1870-1914) when European powers, the United States, and Japan rapidly colonized most of Africa, Asia, and the Pacific. Driven by industrial capitalism, nationalism, racial ideology, and strategic competition, the New Imperialism brought 85% of the world under Western domination and created global inequalities whose effects persist today.
